name: singularity-arcade-game

scripts.vendor:engine: rm -rf public/vendor/arcade-graphics-engine && mkdir -p public/vendor/arcade-graphics-engine && cp -r ../ArcadeGraphicsEngineAndLibrary/dist/. public/vendor/arcade-graphics-engine/ && find public/vendor/arcade-graphics-engine -type f \( -name '*.cjs' -o -name '*.map' -o -name '*.d.ts' -o -name '*.d.cts' \) -delete && echo 'Re-vendored arcade-graphics-engine from sibling checkout.'
